dialogue.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?

dialogue.text: I think I want to go to the beach, but maybe it will be too crowded.

scenario: Returning a faulty item at a shop
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Nke na-eme ka ọ bụrụ
Nke na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ndoro

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Ndewo, nwere m ugwo nke a n'ebe a, mana ọ adịghị si.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Amaram n'ihi ya. Olee mgbe ole i mere ugwo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: Nke na-akpali abali abuo gara aga. A chọrọ ọkụ nke ọzọ, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Nke a ga-enyere gị aka. Tinye ndepụta a na mee ya. Mgbe a ga-eme, m ga-enyere gị ọkụ nke ọzọ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Daalụ. Ọ bụ na m na-enye gị ugwo nke a n'ime, mana m ga-enweta ọkụ nke ọzọ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Nke a bụ ezi. Ma ọ bụrụ na i chọrọ ndoro nkwa, gbakwunye mere m.

scenario: Booking a table at a restaurant by phone
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Usado para 'hacer una llamada telefónica'.
Expresa obligación o requisito.
Se refiere a la noche del día actual.
En el contexto de restaurante, se refiere a la mesa reservada.
Indica propósito o destinatario.
Plural de 'person'.
Usado en preguntas para 'tener disponibilidad'.
Significa 'disponible' en este contexto.
Se pide el nombre para la reserva.
Se usa en 'under the name' (a nombre de).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to book a table for tonight.
dialogue.translation: Ndewo, chọrọ m ịzụ okpukpere n'ihi n'úbọchì.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. For how many people?
dialogue.translation: Mma. N'ihi mmadụ ole?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For four people, please.
dialogue.translation: N'ihi anọ mmadụ, biko.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have a free table at 8 o'clock. Is that okay?
dialogue.translation: Anyi nwere okpukpere nkwụ n'ime 8 n'ogwugwu. Ọ dị mma?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll call back to confirm later.
dialogue.translation: Ee, ọ dị mma. M ga-azụzurị m n'ihi ịnweta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have your name for the reservation?
dialogue.translation: Ọtụtụ. M ga-ahụ aha gị n'ihi ịzụ okpukpere?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, it's under the name García.
dialogue.translation: Ee, ọ n'okpuru aha García.

dialogue.translation: Ahu m feel ọnụ mma n'oge a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What do you have?
dialogue.translation: Gịnị mere gị?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Isi m na-eri, ma m na-etinye ọnụ nke ọtụtụ.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Ee, m na-etinye feel tired ọnụ nke ụbọchị.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Take this medicine while you are here, and you will feel better soon.
dialogue.translation: Jịọ ụzọ a mgbe ị na-eri, ma ị ga-feel mma mgbe ụfụ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Welcome to my hometown! It's a small place, but I love it.
dialogue.translation: Nnọọ na mụ n'ulo m! Ọ bụ obodo mmadụ nke ọma, mana m chọrọ ya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks! Where do you live exactly?
dialogue.translation: Daalụ! Ebee ka ị nwere mmadụ n'anya?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I live near the old church. It's very beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, nice! Is there a market every day?
dialogue.translation: Oo, ndoro! Ọ bụghị ugwu ndoro n'ụbọchị niile?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, and I walk there every morning to buy fresh things.
dialogue.translation: Ee, ma m na-agba ndoro n'ụtụtụ niile ka m zụ ndoro mme.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. Then we can go together tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Nke a bụ ndoro nke ọma. Ọ bụghị ka anyị ga-eri n'ụbọchị echi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to change my reservation for a different day.
dialogue.translation: Ndewo, achọrọ m inye okwute m n'ụbọchị ọzọ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want to come earlier or later?
dialogue.translation: Nke a dị mma. I chọrọ ịbanye nkwụ ma ọ bụ eziokwu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Later, please. Is a room available for next week?
dialogue.translation: Eziokwu, biko. Enweghị ike n'ime ụlọ n'oge ndị a?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me check. We have another room free after Monday.
dialogue.translation: M mere m ezi. Enweghị ike n'ime ụlọ ọzọ n'ime Mọnịde.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I change my reservation to that day?
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma. M ga-emelite okwute m n'ụbọchị a?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but you must confirm before Friday.
dialogue.translation: Ee, mana ị ga-eme n'ihi na Friday.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great! I'll take your advice and choose the mug.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma! A ga-emeri okwu gị na m hụ́ ikuku.

key_phrases.translation: A na-akwụ ọsọ na ị hụ́...

scenario: Talking about past holidays
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you go anywhere last year?
dialogue.translation: I ga-enye anywhere n'afọ gara agụụ?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I went to the beach. The weather was really good there.
dialogue.translation: Ee, m ahu mmiri. Eziokwu dị mma n'ahịa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. Did you get time to relax?
dialogue.translation: O mere mma. I zụtara oge ị nata?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, because it was very quiet. I loved it.
dialogue.translation: Ee, n'ihi na ọ dịrị ndụ ndụ. M mere m mma.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Ndewo! I mere mgbaàkà a?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I visited my grandparents and stayed at their house.
dialogue.translation: M zọpụtara nne m na nna m tụlee n'ụlọ ha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice! Did you enjoy it?
dialogue.translation: Mma! I nụrịnụ ya?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Ee, anyị hụrụ ọnwanyi n'otu n'Mgba Afọ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds great. Did you go out to eat?
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma. I rịọ nri n'elu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, because we cooked at home. It was very relaxing.
dialogue.translation: Mba, n'ihi na anyị rịọrị nri n'ụlọ. Ọ dị mma nke ukwuu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I have an idea: let's invite about ten friends. When is the party going to be?
dialogue.translation: M nwere okwuntụ: let's invite about ten friends. Mgbe ka ụkpụrụ ga-emeri?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Nke ukwa nke izu. Anyị nwere ike ịmalite pastel ukwuu maka ndoro ndoro.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good. I can make the cake, and we can play a fun game outside.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma. M nwere ike ịmalite pastel, ma ọ bụrụ na anyị nwere ike ịmalite akụkọ ndoro ndoro n'ụzọ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect. Now we only need to buy the decorations.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma. Anyị nwere ike ịmalite ịzụ ndoro ndoro.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great, we have a plan! When you go, remember to get some balloons too.
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị mma, anyị nwere ike ịmalite plan! Mgbe ị ga-emeri, chọpụta ịzụ balloons nke ọzọ.

dialogue.text: I see. My apartment is small too, but it's near a quiet street.
dialogue.translation: M mere. Ulo m nke ọma, ma ọ nọ n'okpuru ụzọ eziokwu.

scenario: Making plans for the next day
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-eme ka ọ bụ 'in the morning'.
Mee ka ị tụọ ndụ n'ime ndị mmadụ.
Ọ nwere ike ịbụ noun: 'a call'.
Nkwụ nwere ike ịbụ n'okpuru 'late'.
N'ime ụbọchị nwere ike ịbụ n'okpuru 'late'.
Ọ dị mma, mana ọghọm nwere ike ịbụ n'ọnụ ọgụgụ ndoro.
Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-eme ka ọ bụ n'ebe.
N'ụzọ dịka 'I'm sure'.
Ọ na-eme ka ọ bụ n'ihi na ụbọchị ma ọ bụ ebe.
Ọ ghọrọ n'ọnụ ọgụgụ ndoro, mana ọ dị mma n'okwu; ọ na-eme n'okwu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to do in the morning tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Gịnị ị chọrọ ịme n'ututu echi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I don't know. Maybe we can meet at the usual place before 9?
dialogue.translation: Aghị m ịmụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike tụọ ndụ n'ebe ndoro n'ihi na 9?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's early for me, but I can call you later to confirm.
dialogue.translation: Ọ nkwụ m, mana m nwere ike kpọọ gị n'ime ụbọchị iji nzọpụta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Okay, but don't call too late because I go to sleep early.
dialogue.translation: Mma, mana kpọọghị gị n'ime ụbọchị n'ihi na m ga-eri nkwụ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll call before 8. Then we can have a good day.
dialogue.translation: Nzọpụta, m ga-akpọ gị n'ihi na 8. Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-eme ka anyị nwere ụbọchị ọma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm sure it will be a nice day.
dialogue.translation: Ọma. M nzọpụta na ọ ga-abụ ụbọchị ọma.

scenario: Complaining politely about a problem
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Usoro ndoro zuru ebe ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere nsogbu ma ọ bụ ntụgharị.
Emepụta maka ịgụnye ndoro ma ọ bụ ịkpesa ike.
Na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ike ma ọ bụ ntụgharị.
N'ime ụzọ nke ụlọ ọrụ, ọ na-egosi ihe ọ bụla na-egosi ma ọ bụ na-eme ka ọ bụrụ.
Emepụta na-akpata na ụzọ nke ndoro dịka 'turn off' na-arụ ike ịgụnye ịkpụsara.
Ụzọ ndoro zuru ebe ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ike ịgụnye ma ọ bụ ịnwe ike ịnweghị ike.
Ụzọ ndoro zuru ebe ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ike ịgụnye ma ọ bụ ịnwere ike ịnwereghị ike.
Emepụta na-arụ ike ịgụnye na ụzọ ndoro zuru ebe ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ike ịgụnye ma ọ bụ ịnwere ike ịnwereghị ike.
Emepụta na-akpata na ụzọ ndoro zuru ebe ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ike ịgụnye ma ọ bụ ịnwere ike ịnwereghị ike.
Ụzọ ndoro zuru ebe ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ike ịgụnye ma ọ bụ ịnwere ike ịnwereghị ike.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I have a problem with my room. The TV doesn't turn on.
dialogue.translation: Ndoro m, enwere m nsogbu n'ime ulo m. Agbanyeghị TV na-egosi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it completely off?
dialogue.translation: Akwụsị m ike ịgụnye ndoro. Ọ dịla n'ihi na ọ dịla n'okpuru?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried, but it doesn't work. I really don't understand why.
dialogue.translation: Ee, m na-eme, mana ọ adịghị enyere. M na-enweghị ike ịgụnye n'ihi nke a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe there is a wrong connection. Let me check. I'll make it work soon.
dialogue.translation: Ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere nsogbu n'ime ụzọ. M ga-eme ka m hụ. M ga-eme ka ọ bụrụ nke a n'oge ọma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. I haven't watched anything yet, so I hope you can fix it now.
dialogue.translation: Daalụ. M adịghị n'ihi na m na-enweghi ike ịhụ ụfọdụ n'oge a, mana m na-ahụ na ị nwere ike ịme ka ọ bụrụ nke a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll check it right away.
dialogue.translation: Nke a bụ eziokwu. Akwụsị m ike ịgụnye ndoro nke a. M ga-eme ka m hụ n'oge ọma.

key_phrases.translation: M ga-eme ka ọ bụrụ nke a.

scenario: Talking about a recent film or book
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: E nwere ike ịmalite na mmadụ na-egụọ ọnwa ma ọ bụ televishọn.
Nke ndoro ọma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I watched a new film last night. It was very good!
dialogue.translation: Mụrụ m ọnwa ọhụrụ n'ụtụtụ gara aga. Ọ dị mma!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh really? What's the story about?
dialogue.translation: Ọ dị? Kedu ihe nkà ahụ na-eme?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: Ọ bụ nkà nke mmadụ nwere ike ịgba ụzọ n'ime oge. Mana okpuru ahụ dịghị mma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: Ọ na-eme ka nzọpụta. Mụrụ m akwụkwọ na-enweghị m ike ịgụọ ọnwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Ọnwa ahụ dị ọma ọhụrụ karịa akwụkwọ, m na-eme. Mana n'ihi na m ezighị m akwụkwọ ahụ.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: N'oge m ga-achị m mmechi m, m ga-egụọ ya. Daalụ maka nkwenye!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange

key_phrases.translation: Ọ dị ọma ọhụrụ karịa akwụkwọ

scenario: At a job interview (basic)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: nwere ike ịmalite na ndoro ndoro ma ọ bụ ndoro ndoro ndoro
nsụ na-adịbe ya na ịgụ maka ndoro ndoro
ziga nsụ
kwuo chọrọ
eziokwu nke ọ bụla nwere ike ịmalite
Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-eme ka okwu dị ukwuu
nsụ maka ịrịba ama
okwu nke na-akụ ụzọ okwu
na-eto okwu
nsụ maka oge

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: Ụtụtụ ọma. Enwere m nsụ ndoro ndoro gị. Nke ukwuu, gịnị ka ị chọrọ ịbụ ndoro ndoro?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Nke ukwuu, m enwere ike ịmalite na ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro, ma m enwere akụkọ ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: Aha m. Na-eto, ị nwere ike ịmalite na izu uka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Ee, nke a enwere ike. M nwere ike ịmalite na Mgbaọnụ na Mbọsị.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Mma. Mgbe ị nwere ike ịmalite?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: M nwere ike ịmalite na izu ndoro ndoro nke a nke chọrọ m ịgwa ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro ndoro.

key_phrases.translation: Nke ukwuu, m enwere ike ịmalite
M nwere ike ịmalite na izu ndoro ndoro

scenario: Discussing food preferences at dinner
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ọnụmụ nke ọma: ri / rịrị / rịrị
Iịchọrọ + nke ọ bụla
Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ nke ọ bụla, ọ ga-emeri n'ụzọ nke infinitive

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Gịnị ịchọrọ ịri na abịa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: A chọrọ pasta, ma aghị m ịchọrọ ihe ọjọọ n'ụbọchị a.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Anyị nwere ọtụtụ agwọ na mmiri-egwuregwu na nkụkọ. Ihe a ga-eme ka ọ dị mma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Ihe a na-eme ka mma. Ma m eziokwu ịchọrọ ihe nke ọtụtụ nke ọma.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Kedu ka anyị mezie ihe nri n'ọtụtụ osikapa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Ee, ihe a dị mma. N'ihi na anyị ga-eri ya n'ọnụ, ma m nwere ike ịzọpụta gị nri n'okpuru.

key_phrases.translation: A nwere ike ịzọpụta gị nri

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ọ na-eme ka onye ọbụla nwere ike ịnwere ndoro nke ndoro.
Ọkpụkpere ndoro nke na-eme ka ndoro si.
Ọ na-eme ka ndoro si n'ịdị n'ọnwụ.
Ọ na-eme n'ime ụlọ ọrịa ma ọ bụlụ ụlọ egwuregwu.
Ọrụ n'ime ụlọ ọrịa ma ọ bụ ụlọ egwuregwu.
Ọ bụ ike nke ụlọ ọrịa ma ọ bụ ụlọ egwuregwu.
Ọ bụ ike nke na-egbu.
Ọ na-eme ka ndoro si n'ịdị n'ọnwụ.
Ọ na-eme ka ndoro si n'ịdị n'ọnwụ.
Ọ na-eme ka ndoro si n'ịdị n'ọnwụ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Podrías azaghị m? Ichọrọ m ịkpọ ụlọ egwuregwu m, mana akwụkwọ adịghị iche.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Mma. M ga-eme ka m hụ. I zụrụ ọnwụ ọnọdụ?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Ee, m zụrụ ya. Mana ịchịrịghị. Ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere nsogbu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Ụzọzụ ọzọ. Nke a ga-eme ka ịchịrị n'oge ndoro.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Mma, m ga-achị. Mana n'ihi na ọ nwere nsogbu, ichọrọ m ya ugbu a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: M hụrụ. M ga-eme ka m hụ ọnwụ nke ike. Ah, n'ebe a! Ugbu a, ịchịrị!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Usado ma 'alquilar aha nke a na-akpata n'ulo.'
N'okpuru asụsụ ndị Amerikani, ma ọ bụrụ na ndị nke Britain nwere aha 'flat'.
Ọ bụrụ na ụfọdụ ma ọ bụ ebe ndị na-enweghị ike.
Ọ bụ nsụgharị oge; ọrụ nke na-akpata n'ọnwa.
Ọ bụrụ na nkwụ ụgwọ.
Ọ bụrụ na ị na-akpata n'ụgwọ.
Ọ bụrụ na ụlọ nke na-egosi ọnụ ụlọ.
Ọ bụrụ na ị na-akpata n'okpuru.
Ọ bụrụ na ị na-akpata n'ime.
Ọ bụrụ na ị na-akpata n'ọ bụrụ na.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Ndewo, achọrọ m ịnụ alụgharị aha n'ụlọ. Ọ bụrụ na enweghị ike ugbu a?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Ee, enweghị ike. Umuna alụgharị bụ 800 dọlars n'ọnwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Ọ bụrụ na ụgwọ a nwere mmiri na ike ụgbọ ala?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Mba, nwere mmiri nke ọma. Ihe ike ụgbọ ala bụ ọtụtụ.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Na onye onụ ụlọ a na-egosi? Ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere n'okpuru supermarket?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Ọ nwere n'ọnụ ụlọ atọ, ma ọ nwere n'ime supermarket abụọ ndị nke ụkpụrụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike ịbanye ugbu a.

key_phrases.translation: Ọ bụrụ na enweghị ike ugbu a?
